children: The Nasdaq Composite finished August with a 3.93% gain, recovering from back-to-back monthly declines as technology earnings helped lift sentiment, according to Yahoo Finance market data.

The broader market also absorbed renewed uncertainty late in the month. Rising oil prices and fresh U.S.-Iran tensions pressured stocks, while expectations for Federal Reserve policy shifted after hawkish comments from Chair Kevin Warsh. Markets were pricing in more than a 60% probability of a September rate increase.

August's advance followed declines of 3.2% in July and 2.8% in June. Investors now face a potentially tougher backdrop in September as inflation, crude prices, labor-market data and monetary policy remain key market drivers.
What it means for stocks: The Nasdaq enters September with stronger momentum, but higher rate expectations and geopolitical risks could make the next leg of the rally more volatile.

title: Palantir Leads Tech Stocks as Nasdaq Rebounds
